an5.122:1.1: Yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā pañca dhamme bhāveti pañca dhamme bahulīkaroti, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an5.122:1.2: diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā.
an5.122:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno ajjhattaṃ yeva sati supaṭṭhitā hoti dhammānaṃ udayatthagāminiyā paññāya, asubhānupassī kāye viharati, āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī, sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī.
an5.122:2.3: Yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime pañca dhamme bhāveti, ime pañca dhamme bahulīkaroti, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an5.122:2.4: diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā
